# Trójka fixtures

- `home.html`: sanitized excerpt of `https://trojka.polskieradio.pl/`, retaining the observed Next build-manifest URL.
- `ramowka.json`: sanitized `pageProps.data` excerpt from the captured Next `ramowka.json` response.
